title: Contains Duplicate
statement: Return true when any integer appears at least twice in `nums`, and false when every value is unique.
hints: Sorting clusters equal values, so a duplicate is a pair of neighbors.
A set answers membership in expected constant time.
Insert as you scan. The first failed insert is a duplicate.

approaches.name: Sort and scan neighbors
approaches.explanation: After sorting, equal values sit next to each other.

approaches.name: Hash set
approaches.explanation: Reject a value that is already present.

editorial: A set stores the values observed so far. If the current value is already in the set, the array contains a duplicate. Otherwise insert it. The extra memory is linear, and the expected time is linear.
